cc:Work.dc:title: Half of Pacific and Gulf route cells lie more than 130 km offshore; 90% of Great Lakes route cells are within 49 km of shore
cc:Work.dc:description: Cumulative distribution of route-cell distance to the coastline for four coasts; the Great Lakes curve rises fastest, the Atlantic next, and the Pacific and Gulf curves extend hundreds of kilometers.
